title: Video cover, logo and title on one centred lower-third row
use: Event or release video cover: a full-bleed scene, all information in the lower third, one label plate. 16:10 with a 16:9 centre crop kept safe.

fonts.latinDisplay: lettering.cjs: code-drawn glyphs (A-Z, 0-9, / \ - _ + . : [ ] < > | # % ! ? ' and space), rendered as paths
fonts.licence: Source Han Sans/Serif and Noto Sans/Serif CJK: SIL Open Font License 1.1
fonts.note: Fonts are named, not bundled. Install them where the SVG or PNG is rendered; check measures <text> with an advance model at or above their bold widths.

bg.use: expected tone of the key art under the title band; set it to the real art's tone so contrast is checked against it

band_y0.note: title band top (title centre median 0.72H, p25-p75 0.71-0.725)

scrim.note: dark gradient under the lower half; 5/8 samples set the title over the figure and rely on it. Turning it off usually fails contrast

letter_width.note: code-drawn display lettering: glyph width / cap height

letter_chamfer.note: display lettering corner cut / cap height

letter_stencil.note: display lettering stencil gap / cap height (0 = off)

accent_max_share.note: accent-colour area budget as a share of the canvas; measured on the render

guides.note: show safe zones, figure zones and alignment lines in the output

key_art.note: full-bleed scene; figure may sit under the title

relations: Logo and title share one baseline band in the lower third.
Label plate centred under the title band.
Key information stays inside the 16:9 centre crop.
decoration: Bars and rules either side of the label plate.
changesFromStudy: Key-art placeholder is hatched in the declared ground tone so the preview shows what contrast is checked against.

provenance.corpus: ignoredone's space gallery of official Arknights / Arknights: Endfield promotional art (© HYPERGRYPH), reference only, never redistributed
provenance.method: Our own structural skeleton from measured proportions (median of eye-annotated layout boxes, Lab colour measurements). No traced artwork, logos or official text; image and logo areas are hatched placeholder slots.
measured: title centred 6/8; title centre y median 0.72H (p25-p75 0.71-0.725); title area median 16%
title over the figure > 30%: 5/8, hence the default scrim
title band 0.60-0.86H stays inside the 16:10 -> 16:9 centre crop (0.056-0.944H)
